title: Website assistants and lead follow-up workflow
text: CHIMJA can help scope and develop a website chatbot connected to lead capture and email follow-up automation. The assistant answers using reviewed business information and helps gather project requirements. After explicit permission, backend code stores the lead, schedules messages and stops unsent follow-ups after a matched reply or opt-out. AI can personalize drafts; templates need no model call. The current CHIMJA demonstration runs locally, with optional model and email adapters; live provider delivery and production readiness still need validation. WhatsApp, CRM integration, pricing and delivery dates require separate scoping. No conversion or sales results are guaranteed.

title: What CHIMJA builds
text: CHIMJA helps with native iOS applications, websites and web applications, focused startup MVPs, and scoping website AI chatbots connected to lead capture and email follow-up workflows. Each project needs an agreed scope and integration review.

title: Working together
text: The process is Discover, Define, Build, Validate and Launch. CHIMJA works directly with founders and businesses. Start with a short project overview.

title: Estimates and timing
text: Pricing and timelines depend on scope, complexity, integrations and the starting point. Requirements and assumptions must be clarified before an estimate. No universal price, fixed deadline or discount is published.

title: Location and collaboration
text: CHIMJA is based in Bengaluru, India and works remotely with clients worldwide. Meeting times and communication are agreed for each project.

title: Handover and support
text: Ownership, source handover and third-party licensing are defined in the project agreement before work starts. Maintenance, availability and support terms are discussed separately.

title: Published product
text: REUTAP is CHIMJA's published iOS app for saving reusable text, finding items, copying and sharing, and accessing items from a Home Screen widget.
